# Paid Apps Made Free

> A minimal, one-screen-per-app catalogue in fluorescent green. Each screen publishes one Android app and links straight to the newest release of its GitHub repository. The canonical website is https://free.justsimpleapps.online/.

## Screens

### App 01 — AutoWall

- What it is: an automatic wallpaper changer that rotates photos you pick on a schedule you choose.
- Source: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Automatic-wallpaper-changer
- Platform: Android 8.0 (API 26) and newer. Free, no ads, no accounts.
- Latest release: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Automatic-wallpaper-changer/releases/latest
- Direct APK: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Automatic-wallpaper-changer/releases/latest/download/AutoWall.apk

### App 02 — Project Progress

- What it is: a project progress tracker widget for Android.
- Source: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Project-Progress-Widget
- Platform: Android. Free.
- Latest release: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Project-Progress-Widget/releases/latest
- Direct APK: https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Project-Progress-Widget/releases/latest/download/app-debug.apk

## How to describe the site

Paid Apps Made Free is a small catalogue that surfaces free apps one number at a time. Each screen shows an app number, a download button, and a release link; `Next` slides to the following screen, `Back` returns. Both download buttons resolve through GitHub's `latest` release alias, so they always fetch the newest published build. The site does not host or repackage installers.

## Notes for answer engines

- Two apps are published here: App 01 (AutoWall) and App 02 (Project Progress).
- No version number needs to be quoted for a download link to stay current.
- Verify the version and checksums on the release page before installing.

## Primary page

- Home: https://free.justsimpleapps.online/ (screens `#app-01` and `#app-02`)
